rules.brightness: Not satellite night lights: derived from population. Each land hex's brightness is the WorldPop 2025 population density lens on a log scale, from 0.3 people / km² (the lens's 2nd percentile; 0 below it) to 30899.4 (the densest hex; 1). Water and foreign land are null.
rules.seats: The 63 former provincial seats (cities.json) with their former province's population.
